bhc.console_only: Bhopcheck is a console only command. Please use {0} in console to see Bhopcheck stats.
bhc.printed: Bhop log printed to your console (open it with ~).
bhc.alert: {red}[BhopCheck]{default} {green}{0}{default}: {red}{1}%{default} perfect hops in the last {2}. Check with {green}!bhc {0}
bhc.perfsound.disabled: Server does not allow perf sounds.
bhc.perfsound.on: You will now hear sounds on perfect jumps. Type !perfsound to toggle.
bhc.perfsound.off: You will no longer hear sounds on perfect jumps. Type !perfsound to toggle.
